title: 感應馬達製造
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討定轉子電磁結構、製造公差與電機驗證，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore stator/rotor electromagnetics, manufacturing tolerances and machine validation, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。製造參數取決於材料與設計；本課為圖面、模擬和檢驗資料判讀，無帶電耐壓、加工與轉子超速指令。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Manufacturing parameters depend on materials and design; the course interprets drawings, simulations and inspection data, without energized withstand, machining or overspeed instructions.

stages.title: 電磁與材料
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成電磁與材料；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete electromagnetics and materials through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識旋轉磁場：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識旋轉磁場，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.instruction: 用 50 Hz 比較 2、4、6 極同步轉速 3000、1500、1000 rpm。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: At 50 Hz compare 2, 4 and 6 poles: 3000, 1500 and 1000 rpm. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 用 50 Hz 比較 2、4、6 極同步轉速 3000、1500、1000 rpm。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: At 50 Hz compare 2, 4 and 6 poles: 3000, 1500 and 1000 rpm. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識旋轉磁場」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把定轉子電磁結構、製造公差與電機驗證的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
